I directly verified the range-diff from 9543d9ad..c783985c to 31f9ef20..1139cfca. origin/main resolves to the same full 31f9ef20884f66accf8c787d61d56d45367182ea base. Commit 1 differs only in the checks extension description string, retaining both omp-config and copilot-sdk in the sensor list; commit 2 is identical (=). There is no new security-relevant executable delta. Unchanged code was not re-reviewed, and functional C34 follow-ups are not reopened by this confirmation.

The existing nonblocking note remains: installed OMP config get is not provably read-only on persistent global settings/storage. The live sensor was not invoked. No new security finding or blocker is raised.

Finality is restored: just pr-freeze 260 returned FINAL/exit 0 at the exact requested head, with remote/GitHub agreement, main base, CLEAN merge, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. The detached review worktree is clean. This supersedes the old-head finality warning only, not its retained OMP execution caveat.

No local tests, builds, cargo commands, dependency installations, OMP commands, credential-file reads or global-config changes were performed for this rebase-only confirmation. The coder-reported tests were not independently rerun.
